gui.simpleskills.lore.title: The Lost Records of Vhal’Kareth
gui.simpleskills.lore.subtitle: Chronicle of a forgotten civilization beneath the world
gui.simpleskills.lore.coordinates_unknow: The coordinates were lost. Search for traces in the depths.
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.1.title: The World Beyond the Stone
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.1.author: Edran, explorer
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.1.body:
For years, I believed deepslate marked the edge of the known world. I was wrong.

Far below the mines, I found corridors and walls carved by intelligent hands. The inscriptions repeated one name: Vhal’Kareth. If these signs are true, an entire kingdom lies beneath our feet.
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.2.title: Architects of the Deep
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.2.author: Edran, explorer
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.2.body:
Vhal’Kareth was not a single city, but a kingdom built inside colossal caverns. Its people mastered runes and raised halls that seemed to defy the stone itself.

The records speak of the Abyssal Bridge: a monumental structure spanning an underground void from wall to wall, joining distant parts of the realm. It was no way out. It was a monument to its builders.
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.3.title: The Crimson Gift
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.3.author: Fragment of a royal archive
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.3.body:
In the depths, we found a crystal with a crimson glow. Its energy strengthened our runes, fueled our forges, and made once-unthinkable works possible.

The king called it a gift and ordered it studied. Soon, red veins appeared in the walls. Workers heard whispers, and some never returned. Even so, stopping the extraction seemed unthinkable.
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.4.title: The Crimson Rupture
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.4.author: Account of a survivor
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.4.body:
The crystal was no longer a source of power. It spread through walls, invaded halls, and changed everything it touched. Some inhabitants were transformed; others vanished into the deep.

We named it the Crimson Rupture. The earth shook, streets were buried, and entire structures collapsed. The final orders were to evacuate the cities and seal the passages. It was already too late.
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.5.title: The Last King
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.5.author: A royal councilor
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.5.body:
Our king was Vhal’Kareth’s greatest warrior. Powerful, respected, and master of the ancient runic arts, he personally led the resistance against the corruption. He refused to abandon his people.

When I last saw him, crimson marks covered his armor and his voice had changed. I do not know whether he was corrupted or still fought against it. He returned to his throne. No word ever came from the sovereign again.
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.6.title: The Bridge Record
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.6.author: Cartographer of the final expedition
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.6.body:
I recovered part of the Abyssal Bridge map. It should still rest in the depths, spanning the void between two natural walls. Its pillars and arches may be broken, buried beneath rubble, or hidden by formations that grew over centuries.

The coordinates below mark the recorded position of the structure. Look for worked stone beneath the rock.
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.7.title: The Abyssal Castle
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.7.author: Cartographer of the final expedition
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.7.body:
The Abyssal Castle was the heart of Vhal’Kareth. It held the throne, the royal archives, and the survivors’ last refuge. I believe the king remained in its halls until the end.

These coordinates mark the area indicated by the map, not a guaranteed entrance. Cave-ins may have buried entire walls, and natural formations may cover what remains. Should you find the throne room, do not assume it is empty.

gui.simpleskills.lore.page.8.title: The Crimson Colossus
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.8.author: Entry from a chamber sentinel
gui.simpleskills.lore.page.8.body:
At the heart of the greatest crystal rests a creature of Abyssal stone, crowned with crimson spires. The crystals along its back pulse when someone crosses the arch; then the guardian awakens.

The colossal formation marks the center of the Crimson Caverns. Follow the coordinates and seek the great crystal arch. The arena lies deep in the Abyss; its exact height follows the natural cavern floor.
